- https://github.com/SystemArchitectDGCP : separate institutional account.

## Interpretive Rules
- **No free DGCP™ system use:** express owner authorization and paid license/commercial agreement required.
- **No evidence disclosure:** original Proof, DU, Raw Data and private records are not offered here.
- **No mandatory daily records:** existing folders are not a commitment to public reports.
- **No inferred rights:** public visibility is not an open-source license.
- Respect independently applicable source licenses and rights; no retrospective amendment is implied.
